messages:
Nadia (Infra PM): follow-up from today's all-hands: can we get a short, customer-facing explanation of how APAC autoscale will behave during the upcoming holiday surge? the deck mentioned "warm pool" and "spillovers" but customers asked for specifics. cc @Tom

Tom (VP Infra): short version for customers: we prioritize latency-sensitive routes on APAC warm pool; when that saturates we spill to preemptible capacity in-region, then to remote capacity as needed. we'll provide a one-liner and an FAQ entry.

Jin (SRE): ops note: routing order now is regional-warm -> regional-preempt -> remote-warm -> remote-preempt. preempt detection fires if preempt_rate > 0.18 over 60s.

Priya (Platform): console plan: add a per-route "warm usage" percentage and a spill log tag `spill_reason=preempt` so teams can correlate. ETA next week.

Lena (Support): can we get a canned sentence to use in CS tickets? we want something short and non-technical.

Tom (VP Infra): suggested: "During peak regional demand we briefly use lower-cost preemptible capacity to preserve throughput; premium routes remain on our regional warm pool for latency guarantees."

Nadia (Infra PM): action items: 1) Priya to post console mock + API names 2) Jin to share preempt dashboard link 3) Nadia to draft FAQ and sample CS line. target: EOD Thu.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: autoscaler/v2 -> staging at 2024-05-10T15:12:01Z. monitor: warm-pool-util, preempt-rate.

Jin (SRE): testing tip: run `make stress TEST=holiday/apac-spill --observe` to validate client backoff behavior.

Nadia (Infra PM): thanks team ":white_check_mark:" I'll summarize and post to the all-hands thread.
